_meta.description: Canonical lesson registry — the single source of truth for the (band, lesson) curriculum. See ./README.md for the taxonomy and naming rule.
_meta.phaseRule: phase is DERIVED, never stored: lesson <= 10 -> phase 1, else phase 2
_meta.slugRule: {band}-{NN}-{slug}; game id and folder == band-NN-slug; ageBand == band in caps

fields.title: canonical title (PDF master index)
fields.altTitle: title used by the per-lesson teacher script when it disagrees with the PDF
fields.tools: normalized platform-tool tokens the lesson needs (builder/capability hint)
fields.lessonGroup: links cross-band twins of the same lesson (contract manifest.lessonGroup)
fields.hasScript: a detailed 25-minute teacher script exists (the docx) -> can pass Gate 0 once split into source/

k2.title: AI, Meet My Shapes!
k2.objective: Teach AI to recognize 3 shapes (circle, square, triangle) via drawing; test if AI remembers.

k2.title: Robot Builder
k2.objective: Review shapes; generate a simple robot from 2-step shape instructions.

k2.title: Color the Rainbow
k2.objective: Teach AI 3 primary colors (red, blue, yellow) by coloring shapes on tablet.

k2.title: Color My Robot
k2.objective: Review colors; generate a colored robot from voice instructions; color quiz.

k2.title: Nature Hunt
k2.objective: Teach AI nature items (sun, cloud, flower) by pointing to a real photo.

k2.title: Animals Stamp & Test
k2.objective: Review nature; teach AI animals with toys & picture cards; AI tests students ("Show me a duck").

k2.title: Invent a Silly Animal
k2.objective: Review game; students invent a hybrid animal, teach AI, AI generates it.

k2.title: AI's Feeling Cards
k2.objective: Teach AI emotions (happy, sad, angry) using face picture cards; matching game.

k2.title: Add a Smile
k2.objective: Review emotions; teach AI emotions via drawing faces; generate a face on the robot.

k2.title: Let's Throw AI a Birthday Party!
k2.objective: Kids tell AI what to put in a birthday picture; AI generates the whole scene.

k2.title: Apple, Banana, Bear
k2.objective: Teach AI fruits (apple, banana) and one animal (bear) using real toys; test by showing & asking.

k2.title: Play-Doh Fruits
k2.objective: Review fruits; students make a fruit with play-doh, show AI, AI names it (3D -> digital).

k2.title: Jump, AI, Jump!
k2.objective: Teach AI body movements (stand, jump, clap) via joint recognition; AI repeats the name.

k2.title: Dance with Me
k2.objective: Review movements; teach AI a simple 2-step dance (clap -> jump); AI performs back via avatar.

k2.title: What's That Sound?
k2.objective: Teach AI sounds (clap, stomp, "wow"); record, label, AI repeats sound back.

k2.title: Make a Beat
k2.objective: Record 3 sounds, arrange into a 4-beat song; AI generates song from the arrangement.

k2.title: Point & Learn
k2.objective: Teach AI body parts (head, shoulders, knees, toes) via pointing on a body diagram.

k2.title: AI's Turn to Lead
k2.objective: AI gives simple movement commands ("touch knees"); students follow.

k2.title: Charades with AI
k2.objective: Teach AI animal actions via joint recognition; play animal charades, AI guesses.

k2.title: Animal Dance Party
k2.objective: Choose an animal from Phase 1; AI animates that animal leading a simple dance.

k3.title: Zoo Visit
k3.objective: Teach AI 3 new animals (giraffe, zebra, elephant) using toys + play-doh stamps.

k3.title: Follow the Pattern
k3.objective: Play a pattern-recognition game (shapes/colors); AI asks "What comes next?"

k3.title: AI Architect
k3.objective: Generate a house using shapes + 2 colors (e.g. "star window, red roof").

k3.title: Emotion Mix-Up
k3.objective: Teach AI new emotions (scared, surprised) using drawing + picture cards.

k3.title: Arrange the Feelings
k3.objective: Arrange 3 picture scenes (lost toy -> sad -> find toy -> happy); AI generates 1 sentence per scene.

k3.title: Left, Right, Up, Down
k3.objective: Teach AI finger directions; combine into a pattern (left -> up -> right).

k3.title: My Own Instrument
k3.objective: Record 5 sounds; arrange into an 8-beat song; AI generates a melody.

k3.title: Fingers-and-Joints Dance
k3.objective: Teach AI finger directions plus joint movements; combine into a 4-step dance.

k3.title: Tell Me a Story
k3.objective: Generate a 3-sentence story: character (robot), setting (garden), feeling (happy).

k3.title: Instant Story Time
k3.objective: Students generate one scene; AI describes it in 1 sentence.

k3.title: Numbers on Fingers
k3.objective: Teach AI numbers 6-10 using fingers; counting game (AI flashes fingers, kids say number).

k3.title: Play-Doh Fruits
k3.objective: Students make a fruit with play-doh, show AI, AI names it (3D -> digital).

k3.title: Fruit Animal
k3.objective: Generate a hybrid (e.g. "a bear with an apple body").

k3.title: Arrange the Story
k3.objective: Arrange 4 story scenes; AI generates 4 sentences total; class votes on best story.

k3.title: Make a Monster
k3.objective: Generate a monster from a few descriptive words (color, texture, body parts, emotion).

k3.title: Step, Step, Stop
k3.objective: Teach AI a sequence via joint recognition (step left, step right, stop, wave).

k3.title: AI Music Video
k3.objective: Combine song + dance; AI generates a full 30-second performance.

k3.title: What Am I?
k3.objective: Describe an object (sun, duck, apple); AI must guess within 3 tries.

k3.title: Happy Feet, Angry Stomp
k3.objective: Teach AI to connect emotion -> movement (happy = bouncy steps, angry = stomp).

k3.title: AI & Me: The Movie
k3.objective: Compose a full scene (character, setting, feeling, actions, 2 objects, 1-sentence story); AI animates it.

primary._note: Primary bands are p1-p6; lesson cut + AI City Architect curriculum TBD (PLAN open decisions).
